purpose: Define one native hash-bound manifest for reproducible formal Runs and deterministic rejection of silent reuse.

abstract_mechanisms_observed: Bind Run facts and artifacts by hash.

inputs.name: run_capture
inputs.description: Bind Run ID; every input and raw manifest; Git commit/tree; executable/config; seed; allowlisted environment; dependency lock; tokenized command; start/end/duration; exit/signal; solver/model; expected/actual outputs; metrics; failure; supersession; and credential-free reproduction command. Artifacts have size and SHA-256; absence is explicit.

outputs.name: manifest
outputs.description: One canonical manifest with self-excluding hash, verification, eligibility, and STALE result.

state_write_set: native Run manifest/status by main agent

preconditions.statement: All required bindings are authoritative and secret-free.

postconditions.statement: One verified native manifest exists; ineligible outcomes remain explicit.

invariants.statement: Same capture yields identical bytes and hash.
Any bound mutation causes transitive STALE.
Failed, partial, stale, superseded, or environment-mismatched Runs are INELIGIBLE; only main agent writes state.

hard_failures.statement: Missing, invalid, or mismatched binding rejects.

algorithms.specification: Normalize bindings and project-relative paths; reject missing or forbidden values; recompute sizes and SHA-256; classify success, failed, partial, stale, or superseded; eligibility requires every binding match, zero exit, complete outputs, no failure, current status, exact replay environment/dependencies/command/seed/solver/model, and privacy PASS; canonicalize excluding self-hash, hash, insert, and reverify. Replay creates a new Run. Mutation or supersession propagates STALE to all dependents.

deterministic_enforcement.statement: Schema, hashes, privacy, lifecycle, replay, and STALE checks use no votes or model judgment.
Verifier requests changes; main agent alone commits them.

agent_responsibilities: Main agent writes; helpers verify without inventing facts.

stale_propagation.statement: Changed bindings or supersession stale all reachable dependents until recomputed.

failure_modes.trigger: binding missing, invalid, sensitive, or mismatched
failure_modes.consequence: verification fails; INELIGIBLE and STALE where applicable
failure_modes.recovery: correct authority data and rebuild without fabrication

failure_modes.trigger: failed/partial execution, replay mismatch, or supersession
failure_modes.recovery: preserve it and create a new linked Run

recovery_behavior.statement: Rebuild only from immutable capture; never rewrite failure, bypass hashes, leak secrets, or waive mismatch.

audit_events.when: build, verify, classify, mismatch, supersede, or stale

security_constraints: Offline only; no third-party execution, web, MCP, API, browser, benchmark answers, or unverified hashes.
Tokenized commands and project-relative paths only; no shell expansion, traversal, votes, or overrides.
privacy_constraints: Never store credentials, keys, passwords, browser state, hidden reasoning, raw private traces, or unnecessary private paths.
maintenance_surface: Run schema, hashing, fingerprints, lifecycle, privacy, tests

acceptance_metrics.threshold_or_formula: 100% binding/mutation/determinism/STALE coverage; 0 leakage, silent reuse, or ineligible success

rejection_conditions: Any required binding, rule, test, privacy control, or evidence link is absent or bypassable.
Parallel truth, sensitive storage, silent mutation, ineligible success, third-party copying, or non-main state writes.
rollback: Supersede draft; preserve manifests and STALE affected dependents.
migration: Extend native Run atomically; incomplete history stays INELIGIBLE without fabricated backfill.
unknowns: Native field mappings, fingerprints, solver/model identity, credential replay, and timing limit.
open_risks: Undeclared dependencies, fingerprint or secret-scan gaps, scale, lineage defects, and non-replayable services.
